displayName: OCI-RECONNAISSANCE-125: SNMP Community String Brute Force
description:
Detect SNMP community string brute forcing revealing device info

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_reconnaissance_reconnaissance_125", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "dstport" IN (161, 162) AND "value" > 0
